page_title: RAY 1-0 VLL | Rayo Vallecano v Valladolid 07/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Jesus Manzano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Mario Martin (Valladolid) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.
84' Mario Martin (Valladolid) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
83' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Isi Palazon.
83' It's time for a substitution. Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Jorge de Frutos.
82' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post.
82' Anuar (Valladolid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Augusto Batalla.
81' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
79' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano), whose header floated just over the bar.
78' Diego Cocca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Darwin Machis (Valladolid) replacing Antonio Candela.
78' Substitution. Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) in, Marcos Andre out.
78' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
77' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
76' A cross from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

75' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
75' The free kick into the box finds Marcos Andre (Valladolid), who directs his header into the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping.
74' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
73' Mario Martin (Valladolid) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece.

71' 1 - 0 Jorge de Frutos sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
69' Tempers flare after Adam Aznou (Valladolid) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
68' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar.
67' The referee blows his whistle as Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in his challenge.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) is brought on as a substitute for Chuki.
65' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid).

65' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.

62' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

61' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Karl Hein thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
60' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
59' Close! Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
58' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece.
58' Substitution. Adam Aznou (Valladolid) replaces Javier Sanchez.
57' Anuar (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
54' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post.
54' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender.
52' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
52' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
52' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

51' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
50' Chuki (Valladolid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
49' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Excellent touch by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
46' Inigo Perez has made a change at the break. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) has come on in place of Pathe Ciss.
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Manzano starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+1' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jesus Manzano saw the whole situation.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A pass lands at the feet of Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
43' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
41' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jesus Manzano stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
38' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid).
37' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner with a short pass.

36' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
36' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
34' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
32' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
30' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
29' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
27' David Torres (Valladolid) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
25' Luis Perez (Valladolid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
23' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch after Unai Lopez signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
22' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Sergio Guardiola.
20' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
19' It looks like Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) saw red with that tackle. Jesus Manzano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
17' Jesus Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mario Martin (Valladolid).
16' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
16' Rough tackle by Anuar (Valladolid). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Valladolid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

15' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla makes a nice save.
13' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
12' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
11' Mario Martin (Valladolid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick from a promising distance.
10' A snap shot by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Karl Hein produces a good save to thwart him.

9' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
6' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
5' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
4' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a chip pass into the box, but Karl Hein is quickest to intercept the ball.
3' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) plays a through ball but overhits it.
2' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Valladolid will take the kick-off.
Jesus Manzano was nominated as the referee for this game.
